Dear Colleagues,

I am writing to share several important updates across our operations, commercial performance, supply chain, and leadership.

**Quality Findings: Early Assembly Faults**
Our latest testing has identified that 4–6% of units show a fault in early testing following assembly. To address this, we will introduce additional module tests before assembly. We expect this measure to resolve the issue at its source and strengthen the reliability of the units we deliver.

**Nordic Customer Retention**
Customer churn in the Nordic region has risen, primarily among our small accounts. Our sales team believes the recent price change, rather than the product itself, is the main driver. We will continue to monitor the situation closely and will share further updates as our understanding develops.

**Nordtak Supplier Contract**
We have decided to pause the Nordtak supplier contract rather than cancel it. Switching suppliers mid-year would delay our Q2 production ramp by approximately two months, and pausing allows us to protect our timeline while preserving flexibility.

**Reykjavík Office Leadership**
Anna Jónsdóttir will take over leadership of the Reykjavík office. This transition will take place once the current lead has completed the ISO certification audit, ensuring continuity through this important milestone.

Thank you for your continued dedication and hard work. Please reach out to your team lead with any questions.

With best regards,
